import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
pittsburgh = ee.Geometry.Point(-79.9959, 40.4406).buffer(10000)  # 10km buffer
years = list(range(2010, 2019))  # 2010 to 2018
month = 2  # February

# 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
collection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY')
temps = {}
fail_year = None

for year in years:
    # Filter for February of the year
    col = collection.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')) \
                    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(month, month, 'month'))
    
    # Check collection size
    size = col.size().getInfo()
    if size == 0:
        print(f"{year} Images: 0")
        fail_year = year
        break
    
    # Get the monthly image (one per month)
    img = col.first()
    
    # Count valid pixels
    count_dict = img.select('temperature_2m').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=pittsburgh,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    count = count_dict.get('temperature_2m').getInfo()
    if count == 0:
        print(f"{year} Valid Pixels: 0")
        fail_year = year
        break
    
    # Compute mean temperature
    mean_dict = img.select('temperature_2m').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=pittsburgh,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    temp_k = mean_dict.get('temperature_2m').getInfo()
    
    # Validate temperature value
    if temp_k is None or not (200 < temp_k < 330):  # Rough valid range for Kelvin
        print(f"{year} Temp Invalid: {temp_k}")
        fail_year = year
        break
    
    temps[year] = temp_k
    print(f"{year}: {temp_k:.2f}K")

# 3. Handle Failures
if fail_year is not None:
    # Determine failure type
    col_fail = collection.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(fail_year, fail_year, 'year')) \
                         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(month, month, 'month'))
    size = col_fail.size().getInfo()
    if size == 0:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        # Check pixel count if collection exists
        img_fail = col_fail.first()
        count_dict = img_fail.select('temperature_2m').reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=pittsburgh,
            scale=10000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        )
        count = count_dict.get('temperature_2m').getInfo()
        if count == 0:
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    # 4. Comparison
    temp_2018 = temps[2018]
    other_years = [y for y in years if y != 2018]
    is_warmest = all(temp_2018 > temps[y] for y in other_years)
    
    # 5. Output Final Answer
    if is_warmest:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
